items.text: 🪡: That’s why I was proud to work with Mazon to create a new basic needs allowance for military families and support strengthening SNAP and other nutrition programs. As we gather for Passover, let us continue working to make sure every family has food on their table.

My team and I volunteered at the @SDFoodBank and met with their staff to talk about the food and nutrition needs in San Diego. Addressing food insecurity is one of my top priorities, and I'm grateful to everyone in our community who has stepped up to help those in need. https://t.co/NxctFYQo5B

My office was happy to attend the Jacobs Fitness Center renovation celebration at the Lawrence Family Jewish Community Center. This fantastic community resource provides fitness and wellness programs for all interests and ages! https://t.co/qjrjM6otF7

Explain to me again how this is pro-life?
https://t.co/4yvgAJw0cC

HIV stigma and discrimination are deadly. We need to urgently end the stigma, ensure access to preventative medicines like PrEP for all those at risk of contracting HIV, including gay and bisexual men, and improve access to testing and treatment. #NGMHAAD https://t.co/BSiASTBcPw

No one should be hungry in the wealthiest country in the world. As the White House convenes its Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health, I hope we capitalize on this opportunity to make sure everyone has the resources to put food on the table.
During Breast Cancer Awareness Month, it’s important to remember that early detection saves lives. Learn the signs and symptoms here: https://t.co/sZ4ZrmReS8 https://t.co/xswWcK1dz8

Glad my team joined the American Cancer Society’s Making Strides Against Breast Cancer walk this weekend. I’m pushing for federal support for screening, treatment, and research so we can achieve President Biden’s goal to reduce the cancer death rate by half within 25 years. https://t.co/jpdB6NuVaB
On World Pancreatic Cancer Day, we join together to push for more screening, treatment, research, and care for those diagnosed with pancreatic cancer. #WPCD https://t.co/LlzxsB5XhK
On #WorldAIDSDay, let’s recommit to expanding access to testing, treatment, and prevention and ending the stigma toward those living with HIV/AIDS. Together, I know we can end this epidemic.

Enduring stigma and structural barriers continue to prevent the Black community from accessing the HIV/AIDS testing, prevention, and treatment they need. On #NBHAAD, we need to do more to address these barriers so we can finally end this epidemic. https://t.co/XBpYSGmSoT

As the sister of a trans brother and a gender non-conforming sibling, the fight for LGBTQ+ rights is so personal to me. It was great to visit the Transgender Health & Wellness Center and learn about their mental health services, legal support, and more for the trans community. https://t.co/7sk9zvAItN

Breast cancer affects 240,000 women in the U.S. every year. During Breast Cancer Awareness Month, it’s important to understand risk factors, early detection, and common symptoms. For more info: https://t.co/9eJwB4444X https://t.co/3CSFz66MGa

I'm so glad that @POTUS heeded our demand for action and included $310 million to fix the inadequate wastewater treatment system in his supplemental funding request. This won’t solve everything, but it’s a big step in the right direction.

Strep throat cases are rising – but some parents can’t get the medicine they need for their kids because of drug shortages. That’s why I’m pushing my bipartisan Drug Shortage Prevention Act so we can minimize and prevent these drug shortages.

I was so glad to visit @ucmilkbank and learn more about their work to close health equity gaps, improve patient outcomes, and ensure that all newborns have the nutrition they need to grow and thrive. https://t.co/jbwXpVuPSE

We’ve made progress, but we still have a lot more work to do to end the Tijuana River Valley crisis. That’s why I was glad to visit the San Antonio de los Buenos Wastewater Treatment Plant and get an update from Mexican authorities on their progress since the groundbreaking. https://t.co/AbEGmQGCm7

89% of cancer centers reported that drugs used to treat cancer, its symptoms, or side effects from treatment are in short supply. That’s why we need to pass my bipartisan Drug Shortage Prevention Act to help prevent and minimize shortages.
https://t.co/gnzL11Rara

Thanks to Robin for showing me around MVMNT Studio in College Area! I loved hearing about her inspiration behind opening the business and her women-focused exercise model. I want to try out the studio soon! https://t.co/joH0c3HXdW

Stopping the flow of sewage and pollution through the Tijuana River Valley will take collaboration between local, federal, and Mexican officials. So I was glad to welcome @DepSecStateMR to the South Bay wastewater treatment plant to see and understand this crisis up close. https://t.co/AG9tBRthcP

This #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth, it's so important that we focus on early detection and remind our loved ones to get annual screenings. You can check out the signs and symptoms here: https://t.co/p4IfeXzspw

This is unconstitutional and immoral. Our military should never be used in such a grossly politicized way and everyone in this country has a right to due process and humane treatment. We will fight this.

It’s taken longer than it ever should have to address the Tijuana River Valley crisis – but I’m so proud that our San Diego congressional delegation secured $406 million in federal funds this year to upgrade and expand the South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant. https://t.co/Q2ar4AilSY

@SecRubio Eliminating USAID means no more food for millions of Sudanese refugees who’ve fled a civil war, no more medical care for displaced Palestinians, no more HIV treatment on the African continent, and more. People will starve, babies will die, and poverty will skyrocket.

It was great to join the grand opening of @UofSanDiego’s Palomar Health Student Wellness Center! The Center promotes inclusive wellness – from fitness to nutrition to mental health counseling – and includes a teaching kitchen, supported by $850,000 in federal funds that I secured.
